title: Adding or updating OpenAPI-backed MCP tools
answers: How do I add or update an MCP tool in services/mcp?
What files must change together when exposing a new PostHog API endpoint to MCP?
How are generated tool handlers produced from OpenAPI schemas?
body:
1. Tool configuration: add or modify endpoint operation IDs in product YAML definitions (`products/<product>/mcp/tools.yaml` or `services/mcp/definitions/*.yaml`).
2. Schema generation: update Django backend schemas with `hogli build:openapi`, updating Orval Zod schemas in `services/mcp/src/generated/<product>/api.ts`.
3. Tool code generation: run `services/mcp/scripts/generate-tools.ts` to regenerate handlers in `services/mcp/src/tools/generated/<product>.ts`.
4. Catalog registration: verify generated factories are exposed through `services/mcp/src/tools/toolDefinitions.ts` and loaded by `services/mcp/src/hono/tool-catalog.ts:ToolCatalog`.
5. Test validation: update and run schema snapshots in `services/mcp/tests/unit/tool-schema-snapshots.test.ts`.
applies: Applies to OpenAPI-generated MCP tools; does not apply to custom manual tools in services/mcp/src/tools/ or the exec tool.
